data.name: I Trust You Buddy
data.detailed_description:
🌟 Trust Is Your Only Weapon! Dive into a vibrant 3D platforming adventure where teamwork isn't just an option—it's survival! In I Trust You Buddy, you and your best friend will face wacky physics-based worlds, from bouncy inflatable water parks 🌊 to slippery ice glaciers ❄️. The catch? You experience the game completely differently!

🎭 Two Unique Roles, One Shared Destiny:

  • 🐾 The Monster: You are big, fuzzy, and incredibly strong. You can jump high and carry heavy things. But there's a tiny problem: your ridiculously thick, fluffy hair completely covers your eyes! You can't see the gaps, the moving platforms, or the traps. You must rely entirely on your buddy's voice to survive.

  • 👁️ The Guide: You are small, agile, and have a perfect view of the chaotic world ahead. You are always by your buddy's side! Your job? Grab their hand, tell them exactly when to jump, and navigate them safely to the finish line without letting go.

🎙️ Scream, Laugh, and Survive Together Get ready for intense voice chat moments like: "Jump NOW! No, wait, NOT NOW, AHHH!" 😱 This game will test your reflexes, your communication skills, and most importantly, your friendship.

✨ What to Expect:

  • 🤝 True Asymmetric Co-op: Two completely different playstyles. Brains and sight vs. Brawn and pure trust!

  • 🐶 A Fluffy Blind-Spot: Play as an adorable monster who literally can't see past its own bangs, making every jump a leap of faith.

  • 🎢 Physics-Based Chaos: Perfect timing is required to conquer moving platforms, spinning traps, and slippery terrain hand-in-hand.

  • 🌐 Seamless Online Multiplayer: Play with your buddy anywhere in the world with ultra-smooth synchronization.

  • 🌈 Vibrant 3D Worlds: Explore beautifully crafted, colorful environments that are as dangerous as they are cute.

  • 🗣️ Microphone Highly Recommended: Because surviving this game in silence is literally impossible!
